# 中国专利.skill > 专利点挖掘、交底书（发明/实用/外观）与申请文件编写；按图或权要等多条件检索；通俗解读专利和地图探索；审查政策解读；辅助审查答复。 [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE) [![Python 3.9+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-3.9%2B-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/) [![Playwright](https://img.shields.io/badge/Playwright-mermaid%20%2B%20CNIPA-2EAD33.svg)](https://playwright.dev/) [![AgentSkills](https://img.shields.io/badge/AgentSkills-Standard-green)](https://agentskills.io)
有设计文档和代码，但**专利点还没梳**？交底书要**框图 + 可改 Word**？
定稿后还要**多轮补材料、纠错**并留下修改追溯？
公开专利晦涩难懂，想**快速看懂权要与落地语境**？ [初衷](#初衷) · [运行效果](#运行效果) · [子技能列表](#子技能列表) · [支持作者](#支持作者) · [参考文档](#参考文档) · [安装说明](INSTALL.md) · [技能入口](SKILL.md)
--- ## 初衷 ### 专利交底书编写 > **做了多年核心研发，专利发明人那一栏从没写过我的名字。** 代码是自己敲的，方案是自己扛的，轮到交底书却卡在「专利点怎么挖、查新怎么写、框图和 Word 怎么一次交得出去」。本技能把这一环打通：覆盖发明 / 实用新型 / 外观设计，结构图与外观图都能读懂、写进交底；从项目材料梳出可申请的点，查新、脱敏、成文、迭代另存——让真正干活的人，也能把技术贡献写进可交付的交底书里。 ### 专利通俗解读 > **不止一篇。** 公开专利常把阅读门槛抬得很高：权要绕、术语密、落地语境散落在说明书与附图里。本技能把单篇读成通俗笔记与图谱，并入库 Obsidian；依托双链、图谱、插件与 Bases 等生态，陆续解读的专利可以沉淀成**只属于自己的私有专利知识库**——权要、术语、线索与附图彼此勾连，越读越厚。再叠上 [Obsidian CLI](https://help.obsidian.md/cli) 与库内外连接能力，检索、批处理、和外部工具接力都更容易：从单篇通俗笔记，走向可检索、可关联、可继续生长的个人专利情报层，把沉睡在 PDF 里的技术细节重新点亮。库厚了之后，还能在这层之上做**专利比对、挖掘与分析**——同族对照、技术路线梳理、差异点扫描，把「读懂」推进到「用起来」。 --- ## 运行效果 ### 专利交底书编写

candidates.description: Bilingual English and Mandarin text to speech in C++ and GGUF. Voice design, cloning, direction and experimental voice conversion. Vulkan backend, streaming HTTP and WebSocket server, web UI and a C API.
candidates.readme_excerpt:
# Breeze-TTS-2.cpp **Bilingual instruction following text to speech in C++ and GGUF.** Voice design, voice cloning, voice direction and experimental voice conversion, streaming at better than realtime on a mid range GPU.
A C++ / GGUF reimplementation of [BreezeBlue/Breeze-TTS-2](https://huggingface.co/BreezeBlue/Breeze-TTS-2), running on [ggml](https://github.com/ggml-org/ggml). The Vulkan backend means it works across NVIDIA, AMD and Intel GPUs, and it falls back to CPU. Ships a CLI, a streaming HTTP and WebSocket server with a web UI, and a plain C shared library for bindings. English and Mandarin, 24 kHz, roughly 2x realtime at Q8_0 on an RTX 3060, 1.6x with guidance, and the server can run a few streams at once. ## Demo Voice design, cloning, direction, vocal event tags, and voice conversion on a sung recording. Every clip was generated on one RTX 3060, faster than realtime, and nothing was cherry picked. https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b63e4664-497f-4bac-b9e2-50bf571df30a ## Performance Recent versions borrow from [BreezeRT](https://breezeblue.ai/blog/breezert-ultra-low-latency-tts), the low latency runtime from the Breeze TTS 2 team: chunks that start small and grow, the depth decoder compiled into one graph per frame, CUDA graph replay, a vocoder that keeps its state and only decodes new frames, and several streams sharing one GPU batch. On top of that, the vocoder upsamples with a matmul, which is not from that post and was the biggest single win on CUDA. Real time factor for one stream on one RTX 3060 12 GB, with its tensor core limit unlocked, v0.1.5 and v0.1.6 run back to back on the same seeds: | Model | `cfg_scale` | v0.1.5 | v0.1.6 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Q4_K | 1 | 2.15x | 2.41x | | Q4_K | 3 | 1.53x | 1.74x | | Q8_0 | 1 | 1.78x | 1.99x | | Q8_0 | 3 | 1.46x | 1.58x | That is on Vulkan. CUDA at Q4_K measures 2.12x, and 1.70x at `cfg_scale`

candidates.description: Phonon 31M text-to-speech on WebGPU, with word timings
candidates.readme_excerpt:
# Phonon on WebGPU

Fast text-to-speech in the browser, with a start and end time for every word.

[Try it in your browser](https://blixt.xyz/phonon/) (downloads 44.3 MB the first time) · [Listen to the benchmark phrases](https://blixt.xyz/phonon/listen.html)

## What it does

blixt/phonon is a WebGPU runtime for [Phonon 31M](https://huggingface.co/gradium/phonon-31m-en), an Apache-2.0 text-to-speech model by [Gradium](https://gradium.ai). Gradium did not make blixt/phonon. It also runs Gradium's larger 40M models in English, French, German, Spanish and Portuguese, which are not for commercial use ([Other models](#other-models)).

- It makes 24 kHz English speech in any of Gradium's English voices, and streams the audio as it goes.
- It gives the start and end time of every word and of each token in it, while it speaks.
- The speaking speed goes from about 0.77× to 1.3×.
- It downloads Gradium's weights with the large matrices converted to 8-bit integers (43.7 MB, [on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/blixt/phonon-31m-en-webgpu)) and keeps them in the browser's cache.
- It runs in Chrome on macOS and Windows and in Safari on iOS, and a user ran it in Firefox on a Pixel 10 Pro. Other browsers are not tested.
- Without WebGPU it runs on the CPU, in WebAssembly ([The CPU tier](#the-cpu-tier)). On the benchmark's sentences it makes the same take as WebGPU, with the same word times. On an M3 Max it makes speech 37 times faster than real time on 8 threads and 7 times on one, against 11 and 6 times for phonon-tts on the CPU on 3 threads and one.

Against Gradium's own browser package, [phonon-tts](https://www.npmjs.com/package/phonon-tts), on WebGPU, with Phonon 31M:

- Speed: 115× real time against 31× on an M3 Max, 73× against 21× on an RTX 2080 Ti, and 26× against 13× on an iPhone 17 Pro.
- First audio of a sentence: 3 ms against 15 ms on the M3 Max, and 11 ms against 44 ms on the iPhone.
- A fresh page with the model cached: first audio after 46 ms against 373 ms on the M3 Max.
- First visit: 44.3 MB to download against 66.8 MB. With the download at 50 Mbit/s, first audio after 7.2 s against 10.9 s on the M3 Max, and 7.3 s against 11.3 s on the iPhone.
- Word times: phonon-tts gives none.
- Speech quality: Whisper heard no word errors in 110 clips, against 0.22% for phonon-tts. Speaker similarity is the same, and UTMOS predicts 4.40 for both.

## Results

candidates.description: Unofficial NVIDIA RE-USE speech enhancement for Apple Silicon, with a Swift SDK and iPhone/Mac samples
candidates.readme_excerpt:
# RE-USE-MLX-CoreML

日本語 | [English](README.en.md)

[NVIDIA-NemotronLabs-RE-USE](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/NVIDIA-NemotronLabs-RE-USE)の非公式Apple Silicon向け移植版です。Swiftライブラリとサンプルアプリを使い、MacとiPhoneで同じモデルによるノイズ除去を端末内で実行できます。

**今回使用しているモデルは、OpenMDW-1.1の条件に従って商用利用できます。** [旧版`nvidia/RE-USE`](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/RE-USE)はNSCLv1の非商用ライセンスです。モデルの版と再配布時の条件は[ライセンスガイド](docs/LICENSING.md#モデルの版と商用利用)を参照してください。

モデルは[RE-USE for Apple Silicon (MLX + Core ML)](https://huggingface.co/AILogDev/RE-USE-MLX-CoreML)から認証なしで取得できます。取得・削除の詳細は[モデル管理ガイド](docs/MODELS.md)を参照してください。

## デモ動画

iPhoneでノイズを除去し、再生中に「ノイズあり／ノイズ除去後」を切り替えるデモです。音声をオンにして聴き比べてください。

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/cecc26f7-bc90-4b8f-83a4-0485c29924ff

## コンポーネント

| コンポーネント | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `ReuseKit` | MLX / Core MLによる推論、音声ファイルの読み書き、RTF計測 |
| `ReuseModelAssets` | Hugging Faceからのモデル取得、整合性確認、削除 |
| `ReusePlayback` | 処理前後の音声を同じ位置で切り替える比較再生 |
| RE-USE Lab | iPhone用SwiftUIサンプルアプリ |
| `reuse-probe` | Mac用コマンドラインサンプル |

`Package.swift`のあるディレクトリがパッケージのルートです。`Sources`にSDKとMac CLI、`Tests`にテスト、`App`にiPhoneサンプル、`docs`に利用ガイドを収録しています。

## 動作環境

- Apple Silicon搭載Mac：macOS 15以降。
- iPhone実機：iOS 18以降。
- ビルド確認環境：Xcode 27.2（Swift 6.4.2）、Metal Toolchain、Python 3。
- モデル：約54.2 MB。Core MLのコンパイルキャッシュ用に追加の空き容量が必要です。

MLX Swiftは0.33.0に固定しています。Simulatorは画面確認用で、推論には実機を使います。

## Swift SDKとして使う

Xcodeの「Add Package Dependencies」で`https://github.com/Corvelis/RE-USE-MLX-CoreML.git`のバージョン`0.2.0`を追加し、`ReuseKit`を選びます。[モデル一式](docs/BUILDING.md#macのコマンドラインサンプル)を用意したら、次のように音声ファイルを処理できます。

```swift
import ReuseKit

let audio = try ReuseAudioFile.read(inputURL, maximumSeconds: 300)
let engine = ReuseEngine(
    modelPack: ReuseModelPack(root: modelDirectory),
    cacheDirectory: cacheDirectory
)
let result = try await engine.enhance(audio.samples, mode: .mlx)
try ReuseAudioFile.write(result.samples, to: outputURL)
await engine.release()
```

URLの指定、処理モード、モデルの取得と削除は[SDKガイド](docs/SDK.md)を参照してください。

## iPhoneで使う

サンプルアプリの画面表示は日本語です。

アプリのビルド前に[モデル配布先とアクセス方法](docs/MODELS.md)を確認し、[ビルド手順](docs/BUILDING.md)に沿ってインストールします。

1. 「モデルをダウンロード」を押します。取得後はオフラインで処理できます。
2. 「動画」から写真ライブラリの動画を選ぶか、「ファイル」から動画・音声を選びます。マイクでの録音にも対応し、いずれも最大5分です。
3. 処理モードを選び、「ノイズを除去」を押します。
4. 結果を再生します。「ノイズあり／ノイズ除去後」で、再生位置を保ったまま切り替えられます。
5. 動画は「写真に保存」または「動画を共有」でMOVとして保存します。音声だけを取り出す場合は「WAVを保存」または「共有」を使います。

動画の映像と向きを保ち、処理後の音声を組み合わせて保存します。動画の選択・保存形式・写真へのアクセスは[動画の使い方](docs/VIDEO.md)を参照してください。

入力音声は16 kHz・monoに変換します。出力は16 kHz・mono・Float32 WAVです。「3回でRTFを測る」は準備実行1回と測定3回を行い、結果のJSO

candidates.description: 让你的命令行 Agent 在后台自己接活、自己跟进到底；平时不烦你，遇到拿不准的事才发卡片找你拍板。
candidates.readme_excerpt:
# Agent Autoloop

**让你的命令行 Agent 在后台自己接活、自己跟进到底；平时不烦你，遇到拿不准的事才发卡片找你拍板。**

**中文** | [English](README.en.md)

[上手](#上手) · [场景模板](#拿来即用的场景模板) · [插件](#插件体系四个方向都能自由替换) · [内核](#内核的四个机制) · [文档](#更多文档)

![架构图](docs/architecture.svg)

## 它解决什么问题？

平时我们用 Claude Code、Codex 这类命令行 Agent，大多是“人守着终端用”：你输一句话，盯着它跑，等它问你下一步；一旦关掉窗口或者人走开，事情就断了。

**Agent Autoloop** 是一个极轻量的自动化中台。它把任务调度做成一个零外部依赖的**内核**，把事件来源、Agent、通知通道，甚至代码上线流水线全部拆成可随时插拔的**插件**。

- **一台电脑、一条命令就能跑。** 装在你的 Mac 或 Linux 上，不用买云服务器，也不用开放公网端口。
- **一行配置接新 Agent。** 不需要 SDK，也不需要改 Agent 源码，能接收提示词并打印最后一条回复的命令行工具都能接。
- **没有后台界面。** 需要你拍板时把卡片推到飞书、钉钉、企微、Slack、Discord 或桌面通知；想看全局进展，敲一行命令。

## 上手

支持 macOS 和 Linux。运行前需要装好 Node 24、Git、curl，以及任意一个你已经登录好的命令行 Agent，不需要 GitHub 账号。也可以直接把[安装说明](INSTALL.md)丢给你的 Agent，让它替你装好。

> **Windows 版：待定。** 很多朋友在问 Windows 版，我都看到了。我现在人在外面出差，手边没有 Windows 电脑，没法真机开发和测试，所以现在还不能在 Windows 上用。这个周末（11 月 7、8 日）回家后，我会把它开发完，做完兼容性测试，再正式推出。进度会更新在 [#17](https://github.com/KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop/issues/17)。

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop/main/install.sh | sh
```

装好后用你本机的 Agent 真实走一遍“提问 → 退出等回复 → 拍板 → 接着干完”：

```bash
agent-autoloop try
```

下面是在终端里的真实输出：

```text
事件发出去了，Agent 开始干活……

Agent 结束了这一轮，问了你一个问题。它现在不占进程、不花 Token。

【等你决定】#1 试跑：选一个颜色
这是一次试跑，选哪个都行。
  1. 蓝色
  2. 绿色
回答：agent-autoloop answer 1 <序号>
答完运行 agent-autoloop status，能看到它接着把活干完。
```

交互终端里直接输入数字回车；非交互终端运行 `agent-autoloop answer 1 2` 选择“绿色”。再跑 `agent-autoloop status`，就能看到它接上刚才的会话并显示“你选了绿色，试跑通过”，还有今天和最近 7 天的轮数、Token 和费用（[统计口径](skills/agent-autoloop/SKILL.md#看情况回答)）。

## 一件事怎么转起来

编号和上面的架构图一一对应：

1. **新事件进来。** 早上 9 点的定时任务、GitHub 上新提的 Issue、业务系统报的错，都变成一条标准事件送进内核。
2. **按规则派活。** 内核照你写的规则，决定交给哪个 Agent、去哪个目录干。同一件事排队时又来的消息，会合并成一轮处理。
3. **干完一轮就退出。** Agent 把结果写在最后一条回复里，进程直接退出。
4. **拿不准才问你。** 碰到删数据、重启服务、花钱、对外发消息这类事，内核通过飞书或桌面通知发一张卡片给你。等你回复期间，它不占后台进程，也不消耗 Token。
5. **点一下，接着干。** 你选完，它接上原来的对话，把剩下的活干完。

能自己搞定的事走图上方的自动闭环：直接办完，或者约个时间（比如半小时后）再醒来复查，全程不打扰你。

## 日常怎么配？

### 写一份规则（`rules.json`）

不需要写胶水代码。打开 `~/.agent-autoloop/rules.json`，在 `rules` 里写清楚**什么事、交给谁、在哪个目录干**。`to` 填 `agents` 里已有的名字。比如每天早上 9 点写早报：

```json
{
  "name": "早报",
  "when": { "cron": "0 9 * * *" },
  "to": "codex",
  "cwd": "~/notes",
  "prompt": "整理昨天的笔记和提交，写今天的早报。"
}
```

外部事件写法一样，只是要先接好来源。比如有人提新 Issue 时交给 Codex，先按[说明](skills/agent-autoloop/SKILL.md#接一个事件插件)在 `sources` 里登记 `github`：

```json
{
  "name": "处理 issue",
  "when": { "source": "github", "types": ["issues.opened"] },
  "to": "codex",
  "cwd": "~/code/app",
  "skill": "handle-issue",
  "parallel": 3
}

[**Website**](https://muse4ai.andrewbabo.com) · [**Download**](https://muse4ai.andrewbabo.com/download) · [**Guide**](https://muse4ai.andrewbabo.com/docs) · [**For agents**](https://muse4ai.andrewbabo.com/agents) · [Tiếng Việt](docs/README-vi.md) ![Website muse4ai.andrewbabo.com](https://img.shields.io/badge/website-muse4ai.andrewbabo.com-1A50D7?style=flat-square) ![MIT licensed](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-2D664D?style=flat-square) ![Windows](https://img.shields.io/badge/Windows-10%20%2F%2011-1A50D7?style=flat-square) ![Node.js 22+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-22%2B-5F5A52?style=flat-square) ![740 tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-740-2D664D?style=flat-square) ![v2.0.0-beta.32](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-2.0.0--beta.32-B4762B?style=flat-square)

candidates.readme_excerpt:
# ai-config ### Shared skills and workflows for Claude Code and Codex. A versioned setup for coding assistants: matching agent roles, reusable skills,
workflow prompts, hooks, and design standards. Personal state stays local. [**Get started**](#install) · [Skill catalog](docs/skills.md) · [Configuration guide](docs/configuration.md) **78** bundled skills   /   **8** agent roles   /   **2** assistants

## What it provides | Part | Purpose | | :--- | :--- | | **Skills** | Design, writing, security, debugging, Apple platforms, deployment, and project maintenance | | **Agent roles** | A matching eight-role roster for planning, implementation, review, and coordination | | **Workflows** | Claude slash commands and installed Codex prompt templates for features, fixes, and reviews | | **Configuration** | Shared defaults, response styles, hook wiring, and private local overlays | | **Design standards** | Typed visual tokens, component specifications, and UI quality checks | | **Installer** | Relocatable links, backups, config validation, and optional browser/LaunchAgent setup | The [skill catalog](docs/skills.md) lists every binding, its assistant availability, source, and attribution. There are 46 Claude bindings and 74 Codex bindings; identical shared packages have one canonical source. Tool-specific adaptations remain separate. ## Install macOS-first. Requires **Bash, Git, and Python 3.11+**. Install Claude Code, Codex, or both separately. candidates.description: Breaking-change detection and monitoring for the APIs you depend on. One engine for OpenAPI documents and MCP servers.
candidates.readme_excerpt:
# API Drifter

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/apidrifter)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/apidrifter)
[![CI](https://github.com/apidrifter/apidrifter/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/apidrifter/apidrifter/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0-blue)](LICENSE)

Finds where your API drifted from its spec. An open-source CLI and MCP server that runs an OpenAPI document against a live implementation and reports every mismatch with two fixes: one if the spec is the source of truth, one if the implementation is. The same engine diffs spec versions and MCP servers.

Website and research: https://apidrifter.com

## Try it in a minute

```sh
# Verify a running API against its spec. Values come from the spec's examples.
npx apidrifter run openapi.yaml --base-url http://localhost:3000

# See what the engine wants to send, fill the gaps, run again
npx apidrifter plan openapi.yaml --out plan.json
npx apidrifter run openapi.yaml --base-url http://localhost:3000 --plan filled.json

# Fail CI on breaking changes between two spec versions
npx apidrifter breaking old.yaml new.yaml

# Snapshot and diff an MCP server, including tool description changes
npx apidrifter mcp snapshot https://mcp.example.com/mcp --out before.json
npx apidrifter mcp diff before.json https://mcp.example.com/mcp
```

Exit code 1 means findings at or above the threshold (`--fail-on breaking` by default). Output is JSON when piped, text in a terminal, Markdown with `--format markdown`.

## Use it from an agent

`apidrifter serve` exposes the same capabilities as an MCP server over stdio: `plan_requests`, `run_requests`, `verify_observations`, `diff_specs`, `breaking_changes`, `changelog`, `mcp_snapshot`, `mcp_diff`, `list_rules`.

Claude Code:

```sh
claude mcp add apidrifter -- npx -y apidrifter serve
```

Cursor, Windsurf, or any client that takes a JSON config:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "apidrifter": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "apidrifter", "serve"] }
  }
}
```

Then ask the agent to plan requests for a spec, fill the values it cannot infer, run them against your dev server, and fix whichever side is wrong.

# 我的 AGENTS.md

中文 | [English](README.en.md)

这份 `AGENTS.md` 我用着觉得不错，放出来分享一下。

里面写的都是我在意的事：回答直接一点，别总说套话；能继续做的事就做完，别只给个计划；改代码时少加没必要的东西，也别顺手重构一大片；做完以后，讲清楚改了什么、验证了什么，没做的就别说做了。

还有一部分是对错误处理的要求。该报错的地方直接报错，不要用默认值、空结果或一层层兜底，把真正的问题藏起来。

完整内容：[中文版](AGENTS.md) · [English version](AGENTS.en.md)。

如果你也有类似的习惯，可以拿去参考，按自己的项目删改。使用英文版时，把 `AGENTS.en.md` 复制或重命名为 `AGENTS.md`。项目里已经有约定的话，把需要的部分合进去就好。
